workbook.name: Retail Fulfillment Control Tower Fixture
workbook.description: Generated by streamlit-to-sigma static analysis. Review gaps and parity evidence before publishing.

source.statement:
-- Static SQL query for retail fulfillment and returns data
-- Co-authored with CoCo
SELECT
    o.ORDER_ID                          AS order_id,
    d.FULL_DATE                         AS order_date,
    s.REGION                            AS region,
    s.STORE_NAME                        AS store_name,
    p.CATEGORY                          AS category,
    p.SUBCATEGORY                       AS subcategory,
    o.ORDER_CHANNEL                     AS order_channel,
    o.SHIP_METHOD                       AS ship_method,
    o.ORDER_STATUS                      AS order_status,
    o.QUANTITY_ORDERED                  AS quantity_ordered,
    o.QUANTITY_RETURNED                 AS quantity_returned,
    o.NET_REVENUE                       AS net_revenue,
    o.NET_PROFIT                        AS net_profit,
    o.SHIPPING_AMOUNT                   AS shipping_amount,
    o.IS_RETURNED                       AS is_returned,
    o.IS_CANCELLED                      AS is_cancelled,
    o.DAYS_TO_SHIP                      AS days_to_ship
FROM DEMO_DB.DEMO.ORDER_FACT o
JOIN DEMO_DB.DEMO.STORE_DIM s
    ON o.ORDER_STORE_KEY = s.STORE_KEY
JOIN DEMO_DB.DEMO.PRODUCT_DIM p
    ON o.PRODUCT_KEY = p.PRODUCT_KEY
JOIN DEMO_DB.DEMO.DATE_DIM d
    ON o.ORDER_DATE_KEY = d.DATE_KEY

elements.name: Search by Order ID or Store Name
Avg Days to Ship by Method
Revenue vs Shipping Cost by Store Source
Revenue vs Shipping Cost by Store

columns.name: store_name
columns.formula: [Revenue vs Shipping Cost by Store Source/store_name]

columns.name: shipping
columns.formula: [Revenue vs Shipping Cost by Store Source/shipping]

columns.name: revenue
columns.formula: [Revenue vs Shipping Cost by Store Source/revenue]

columns.name: Status
columns.formula: If(Avg([Data — Load Orders/days_to_ship]) <= 3, "Healthy", Avg([Data — Load Orders/days_to_ship]) <= 5, "Watch", "Critical")

columns.name: Return Rate %
columns.formula: Sum([Data — Load Orders/is_returned]) / CountDistinct([Data — Load Orders/order_id])

columns.name: Cancel Rate %
columns.formula: Sum([Data — Load Orders/is_cancelled]) / CountDistinct([Data — Load Orders/order_id])

elements.body:
**Days to Ship > 5** — Orders that took more than 5 days from order date to ship date.

**Is Returned = 1** — Orders where the customer returned the product.

**Is Cancelled = 1** — Orders that were cancelled before fulfillment.

columns.name: Is Exception
columns.formula: ([Data — Load Orders/days_to_ship] > 5) Or ([Data — Load Orders/is_returned] = 1) Or ([Data — Load Orders/is_cancelled] = 1)
